name: Old Tern
text: Fly South. When this comes home: so do your Birds that missed a fight.
golden_text: Fly South. When this comes home: so do your Birds that missed a fight.
details: Sold, flies south for 2 turns; returns to hand at 2.5× permanent stats. Flying pays no sale gold; played this turn, it sells normally. Early recalls require a missed fight; each trip grows once.
golden_details: Sold, flies south for 1 turn; returns to hand at 3× permanent stats. Flying pays no sale gold; played this turn, it sells normally. Early recalls require a missed fight; each trip grows once.
